name: Namyang Dairy Products Co., Ltd
summary: Namyang Dairy Products Co., Ltd manufactures and sells dairy products in South Korea and internationally. It offers babies products under the Imperial Dream XO, Imperial Kid XO, Imperial Mom XO, I am Mother, Star Grow, Blood Crown, Koko Crown Picky Eater, Namyang KI PLUS PREMIUM, Namyang Shanyang Rufen, Hope Allegy, and Hope Doctor brands. It also provides coffee beverages and mixes, yogurt, beverages, cheese, raw and soyabean milk, and whipping cream and creamer; and Namyang KETONIA, a liquid formula for high-fat ketogenic dietary food for infants and young children, as well as real estate services.
